summary: XRP ~$1.29 (flat 24h). Dated positives ahead of Ripple's Swell 2026 (NYC, starts 27 Oct): Aviva Investors put a tokenized share class of its £22bn sterling liquidity fund on the XRP Ledger; Evernorth (XRPN, ~473m XRP) signed an $80.7m equity facility with a Cantor affiliate, mostly to buy more XRP; Ripple launched 24/7 treasury returns; XRP ETFs had first inflows since July. Heavy promo buzz (NYC subway wraps, 'cleared for takeoff' teaser) is hype, not counted. Up from 0.15.
catalyst_note: Aviva tokenized fund on XRPL (26 Oct); Evernorth $80.7m facility (signed 23 Oct); Swell conference 27 Oct
